applicationDefects.title: Brand search matches only at the start of a brand name, not anywhere in it
applicationDefects.rationale: AC-5 requires GET /brands/search?q= to find brands whose name contains the text anywhere in the name, ignoring case, and names 'craft' finding MightyCraft Hardware as its example. Replayed live without credentials (G7): q=craft and q=fLeX (text inside the name) answer 200 with an empty list, while q=MightyCraft, q=ForgeFlex and q=FORGE (text at the start of the name, FORGE in another case) answer the brand. Case is ignored, but only a prefix matches: the requirement's own example fails. SCN-011 fails at its first step on the same q=craft call. The calls, paths and parameter match the declared endpoint, so the mechanics are right. (Confirmed in run 02-eval; identical failure signature in 04-rerun.)
